how_to_apply: Visit kashmiruniversity.ac.in and click the Jobs/Recruitment link. Read the instructions and the preview of the registration and submission process.
Click the Register as an Applicant link and register with a valid email id and mobile number. Remember the Username and Password.
Log in with the Username and Password.

Key in personal details, educational qualifications and experience, then preview the form. Correct any errors before submitting, as no editing or updating is allowed after submission. Note the Form No.
Deposit the application fee of Rs. 1200/- through online mode only. PwD candidates are exempt.

Submit the print-out of the online application form with enclosures, duly numbered at the right-hand top margin as per the auto-generated serial numbers, and the online payment acknowledgement, properly bound, personally or through Speed Post/ Registered Post to: Office of the Recruitment Section, New Admin Block, University of Kashmir, Hazratbal, Srinagar-190006, J&K.

Online form, then hard copy of the print-out
18-12-2026 up to 4.00 p.m. (online); hard copy by 24-12-2026

content_sections.heading: About PRC
content_sections.text: The Population Research Centre is located at University Campus, Hazratbal, Srinagar (J&K)-190006, and functions under the University of Kashmir, which the notice describes as accredited Grade "A++" by NAAC. The notice states that the posts are likely to continue with the continuation of the Centre by the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare. The posts are likely to become vacant on 31-12-2026.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice lists two posts, one each in the Population Research Centre, and does not name any further department.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: The research score of 75 is counted as per Appendix II, Table 2 of the UGC Gazette Notification dated 18.07.2018. Publications in predatory or dubious journals, or presentations in predatory or dubious conferences, are not considered for academic credit. From 14.6.2019, only research publications in UGC-CARE Listed, Scopus or Web of Science listed journals are considered. Each API score must be supported by documentary evidence in the Performance Based Appraisal System (PBAS) Proforma, with page numbers marked on the supporting documents. ISSN/ISBN, sole or co-author status, refereed or indexed status and local, national or international status must be shown in the publication part of the PBAS Proforma with documentary evidence. Candidates registered for the Ph.D programme before 11 July 2009 are governed by the rules of the institution awarding the degree and are exempt from NET/SLET/SET, subject to all of these conditions: The Registrar or the Dean (Academic Affairs) of the University concerned must certify these conditions. NET/SLET/SET is also not required for Master programmes in disciplines for which UGC, CSIR or a similar UGC-accredited test is not conducted. Where a seven-point grading scale is followed, grade "B" (grade points 3.50-4.49) is regarded as equal to 55%. A relaxation of 5%, from 55% to 50% marks, may be provided to Ph.D holders who obtained their Master's degree before 19 September 1991. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

rows.qualification: Good academic record with a Ph.D degree in Demography/ Population Studies/ Statistics/ Biostatistics/ Economics/ Mathematics/ Sociology/ Psychology/ Anthropology/ Geography/ Social Work/ Public Health; and a Master's degree with 55% marks (or equivalent grade) in the same subjects with specialization or an optional paper in Demography/ Population Studies.
rows.experience: Minimum eight years of teaching and/or research in a position equivalent to Assistant Professor in a University, College or Accredited Research Institution/ industry, with at least seven publications in peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of 75.

rows.qualification: Master's degree with 55% marks (or equivalent grade) in Demography/ Population studies/ Statistics/ Bio-statistics/ Economics/ Mathematics/ Sociology/ Psychology/ Anthropology/ Geography/ Social Work/ Public Health with specialization or an optional paper in Demography/ Population Studies; and NET (UGC or CSIR) or a similar UGC-accredited test such as SLET/SET, or a Ph.D awarded under the UGC Regulations, 2009 or 2016 (exempt from NET).

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: In addition to the Pay Level, D.A., Medical Allowance, House Rent and other allowances admissible to the staff of the Population Research Centre are payable to appointees. The appointee is not entitled to GP fund or pension. Contributory Provident Fund/ NPS/ gratuity and leave encashment apply as permissible under the rules and guidelines of the Ministry. Terms of appointment are governed by the Kashmir & Jammu Universities Act, 1969, its Statutes and Regulations, and the Union Ministry of Health and Family Welfare and UGC rules, whichever applicable. No TA/DA is paid to candidates for appearing in the interview.

content_sections.heading: Shortlisting Criteria for Assistant Professor
content_sections.text: The notice prints a scoring scheme for shortlisting candidates for appointment as Assistant Professor. It does not print a shortlisting scheme for the Associate Professor post. The total is 100: academic score 80, research publications 10 and teaching experience 10. Maximum marks: M.Phil plus Ph.D 30; JRF/NET/SET 07; awards 03.

rows.score: 80% and above = 15; 60% to less than 80% = 13; 55% to less than 60% = 10; 45% to less than 55% = 05
80% and above = 25; 60% to less than 80% = 23; 55% (50% for SC/ST/OBC non-creamy layer/PwD) to less than 60% = 20
2 marks for each publication in Peer Reviewed or UGC listed journals; 10 marks
2 marks for one year each; 10 marks (reduced proportionally if less than one year)
International/National level (International organisations, Government of India or Government of India recognised national bodies) = 03; State level (State Government) = 02

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for PRC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Online forms close on 18-12-2026 at 4.00 p.m.; the hard copy last date is 24-12-2026. For further information, write to [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Print-out of the online application form with numbered enclosures, and the online payment acknowledgement, properly bound. All enclosures self-attested. Originals relating to age, qualifications, experience, fitness and other claims must be produced when asked. Associate Professor: one set of PBAS Proforma, four copies of the latest Bio-data and four copies of seven best publications as books and/or research/policy papers, in spiral binding only (not attached to the PBAS Proforma). Equivalence Certificate from the Association of Indian Universities (AIU), New Delhi, for post graduate/Ph.D degrees from a foreign University; without it the form is rejected.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in PRC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: one Associate Professor (PGD-PR-7) and one Assistant Professor (PGD-PR-8), both for UR.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for PRC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for online forms is 18-12-2026 up to 4.00 p.m. The last date for submission of the hard copy is 24-12-2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Assistant Professor at PRC?
faq.answer: A Master's degree with 55% marks in Demography, Population Studies or the related listed subjects, plus NET (UGC/CSIR) or SLET/SET, or a Ph.D awarded under the UGC Regulations 2009 or 2016 that exempts from NET.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Associate Professor at PRC?
faq.answer: A Ph.D and a Master's degree with 55% marks in the listed subjects, plus eight years of teaching and/or research experience, seven publications and a research score of 75.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for PRC Associate Professor and Assistant Professor?
faq.answer: Associate Professor is paid at Level 13A, Rs. 131400-217100/-, and Assistant Professor at Level 10, Rs. 57700-182400/-. D.A., Medical Allowance, House Rent and other admissible allowances are payable in addition.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for PRC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 1200/-, payable through online mode only. Persons with benchmark disabilities (PwD) are exempted.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for PRC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Register and submit the online form at kashmiruniversity.ac.in, then send a bound print-out with enclosures and the payment acknowledgement to the Recruitment Section, University of Kashmir, personally or by Speed Post/ Registered Post.

faq.question: Q8. Is the PRC Kashmir job permanent?
faq.answer: No, the posts are temporary and likely to continue with the continuation of the Population Research Centre by the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare. The appointee is not entitled to GP fund or pension.

faq.question: Q9. Do earlier Associate Professor applicants need to apply again?
faq.answer: Yes. The post is re-advertised after earlier notices dated 27-12-2024 and 08-05-2026, and those who applied earlier must apply afresh if otherwise eligible.

faq.question: Q10. Will TA/DA be paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA is paid to candidates for appearing in the interview.
